## Architecture

### Service Dependencies

All databases MUST use the shared instances in `/mnt/stacks/docker/central_databases` — do NOT spin up per-project database containers.

- [ ] PostgreSQL (shared via `central_databases`)
- [ ] MariaDB (shared via `central_databases`)
- [ ] Redis (shared via `central_databases`)
- [ ] CouchDB
- [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- [ ] None (standalone)

### Integration Points

- [ ] Forgejo API
- [ ] fh-commons helpers
- [ ] Existing shared config
- [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->

## Implementation Standards Checklist

<!-- DO NOT EDIT this file directly. It is maintained by fhc sync and will be overwritten.
     Source: templates/partials/standards-checklist.md in fh-commons -->

**All items below are MANDATORY. No exceptions.**

### File & Code Structure

- [ ] Max ~500 lines per file; split into packages as needed
- [ ] Modular, config-driven scripts, menus, modals, and forms
- [ ] DRY enforced strictly (no exceptions without prior discussion)
- [ ] No hardcoded values (paths, URLs, ports, file lists from config)
- [ ] Fail fast (no fallbacks, no silent error swallowing)
- [ ] Complies with `ARCHITECTURAL_STANDARDS.md`

### Helper Usage (in priority order)

- [ ] 1. fh-commons helpers checked first (`docs/python-functions-reference.md`)
- [ ] 2. Existing app helpers checked second
- [ ] 3. New helper created only if truly needed (consider adding to fh-commons)

### Docker & Deployment

**All items below are mandatory infrastructure standards.**

- [ ] Uses Docker Compose (`docker-compose.yml`) — never standalone `docker run`
- [ ] `docker-compose.yml` stored in `/mnt/stacks/docker/<project>/`
- [ ] Runs as non-root: `user: "1026:100"` (required for NFS share compatibility)
- [ ] Databases use shared `central_databases` instances (PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Redis)
- [ ] Passwords go inline in `docker-compose.yml` (single-user homelab — no `.env` indirection)
- [ ] Health check configured
- [ ] Restart policy: `unless-stopped`
- [ ] Joins `homelab` external network
- [ ] Volume mounts for persistent data under `/mnt/stacks/docker/<project>/`

#### Reference docker-compose.yml

Use this as a starting point for all new projects:

```yaml
services:
  myapp:
    container_name: myapp
    image: [link]
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "1026:100"
    environment:
      - TZ=America/Los_Angeles
    volumes:
      - /mnt/stacks/docker/myapp/data:/app/data
    networks:
      - homelab

networks:
  homelab:
    external: true
```

### Configuration

- [ ] Project registered in `projects.json`
- [ ] CLI command defined (if applicable)
- [ ] Sync templates configured in `config/sync.json` (if applicable)
- [ ] Labels synced to Forgejo repo (if new repo)

## Testing Requirements (MANDATORY - ZERO EXCEPTIONS)

<!-- DO NOT EDIT this file directly. It is maintained by fhc sync and will be overwritten.
     Source: templates/partials/testing-requirements.md in fh-commons -->


### CLI Tests

- [ ] Real CLI invocations via `subprocess.run`
- [ ] Real filesystem, database, and network operations
- [ ] Coverage: direct feature + regression + adjacent modules

<!-- DO NOT EDIT this file directly. It is maintained by fhc sync and will be overwritten.
     Source: templates/partials/mock-ban.md in fh-commons -->


**Mocks are BANNED. No exceptions.**

| Banned Pattern | Why |
|----------------|-----|
| `unittest.mock` / `@patch` / `MagicMock` | Replaces real behavior with fake behavior |
| `pytest-mock` / `mocker.patch()` | Same — just a different API |
| `Mock()` / `MagicMock()` | Fake objects that hide real failures |
| Dry-run mode as test substitute | Tests must run real commands |

**The pre-commit hook BLOCKS commits containing mock patterns.**

Tests must use:
- Real `subprocess.run()` for CLI commands
- Real filesystem operations (use `tmp_path`)
- Real database/network calls (or `pytest.skip` if genuinely unavailable)

### Browser Tests (if web app)

- [ ] Playwright E2E tests for all user-facing features
- [ ] Real API calls with response data verification
- [ ] State change verification (not just element visibility)
- [ ] All critical user flows covered

### Test Gate

- [ ] `python -m ruff check $(git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- '*.py')` passes (lint)
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_<module>.py` passes (unit)
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/browser/test_<relevant>.py` passes (browser, if web app)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Docker container builds and starts without errors
- [ ] Uses Docker Compose (not standalone `docker run`)
- [ ] Runs as non-root with `user: "1026:100"`
- [ ] Databases use shared `central_databases` (no per-project DB containers)
- [ ] All files stored under `/mnt/stacks/docker/<project>/` (compose + data)
- [ ] Health check passes
- [ ] All integration points functional
- [ ] Config-driven (no hardcoded values)
- [ ] All tests passing (lint + unit + browser if applicable)
- [ ] File size limits respected (max ~500 lines per file)
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks pass
